_comment: Copy to ~/.config/mirror/devices.json, or let `mirror add` write it for you.
Only id, name and title are required. Everything else has a working default.
host   — how to reach the device when it is not plugged in over USB.
A LAN address (192.168.x.x) or a Tailscale one (100.x.y.z) both work;
`mirror add` fills this in for you from a USB-connected device.
Leave it out entirely for a USB-only device.
kind   — phone | tablet. Picks the menu bar icon and decides whether the
'Force landscape' option is offered (tablets only).
usbModelPrefixes — matched against `adb shell getprop ro.product.model` so a
device is still recognised when it appears as a bare USB serial.
Needed only if you mirror more than one device over USB.
screenOffBreaksCapture — set true if scrcpy's --turn-screen-off gives you a
black mirror on this device (true on the Galaxy Z Fold 8/Android 17).
pushTarget — where files dragged onto the mirror window land. Defaults to
/sdcard/Download/FromMac/ so they stay separate from whatever the
device downloaded itself. Dropping an APK installs it instead.
virtualDisplay — size/dpi for `mirror <id> big`, which mirrors a separate
virtual screen instead of the real one. Use the panel's own
resolution, e.g. 2448x1848/420. Omit if you do not want the mode.
The menu bar app offers it as 'Start on a Separate Screen'.
unlockStyle — samsung | generic | none. 'samsung' enables the One UI keyguard
handling (PIN bouncer detection, the accidental-switch-on guard).
'none' never touches the lock screen — neither program wakes it,
dismisses the keyguard, or asks for a PIN.
maxSize — pins the mirror's width, overriding whichever quality level is
chosen (`frugal` / `medium` / `sharp`, or the menu's three). Omit
it unless you need a particular width: the levels are tuned per
link and make a better default than one number for every case.
Optional. Wires the '声音回手机 / Sound back to phone' button into a push
notification when audio starts streaming. Needs the actions-server and
notify services from this same repo, reachable over Tailscale.
Delete this whole block if you do not run them — everything else still
works, and `mirror hush` on the Mac always works regardless.
